{{Top|leg}}
A '''Mono-molecular edge''' was a type of [[Edge (weapon)|edge]] applied to certain bladed weapons.<ref name="EDGECORE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

Different from the [[monomolecular blade]], which was a near microscopic blade a single molecule in thickness, the mono-molecular edge referred to a process that could be applied to most edged weapons. Using sophisticated machinery, an edge was honed down to mono-molecular thickness and then toughened through laser-forging techniques to keep it sharp. The resulting edge, while not as powerful as a Monomolecular blade, was nevertheless exceedingly sharp, and capable of impressive cutting power.<ref name="EDGECORE" />
